messages.text: First site audit and GSC pull complete for phoenixmethodseo.com. April baseline: 90 impressions, 1 click, avg position 9.8, CTR 1.11%. Site is indexed and showing up in 25 keyword queries — strong early signal for a brand-new site. Top impressions: 'google business profile' (pos 2.4), 'google business profile optimization' (pos 8.5), 'conroe seo company' (pos 41 — opportunity to push into top 10). Target keywords like 'seo for therapists' and 'therapist seo services' aren't indexed yet — that's the content gap to close this month. One fix needed now: homepage meta description is 204 chars and getting cut off in SERPs — trim to under 165. Services page and case studies are next.

May data shows strong early traction. Impressions grew from 97 (April) to 652 — a 6.7x jump — as the service pages and canonicalization work from May settle into Google's index. The site now shows up for 73 distinct keyword queries, up from 35 in April. Average position is 73.7 (vs 10.0 in April) because the new keywords entering the index are in deep positions — expected for new content, will improve as pages build authority and we start pushing them with links. Top early signals: 'mental health seo' (51 impressions), 'behavioral health seo' (19 impressions), and 'ai citation optimization' (17 impressions). No agency keyword clicks yet but the footprint is growing. June priority: first blog post targeting 'seo for therapists', GBP listing, and FAQ page.
